schema.title: Response Get Orders Api Orders Get

post.description:
Build an order card from a structured intent (the same object the LLM emits).

Nothing is sent. The card has to be approved separately, and the hash on it is what the
approve call must echo. Ambiguous or unknown instruments come back as a question.

409.description: Nothing was sent: stale, expired, voided, blocked or re-quoted

post.description: Build a plan card from structured steps (the same object the assistant uses). Nothing is sent.

Approve a whole plan. The steps then run in order in the background, each through the same
executor as a single order; follow progress on the WebSocket or with GET /plans/{id}/report.

409.description: Nothing was run: stale, expired, voided, blocked or re-quoted

get.description: Where each step stands: filled, partly filled, rejected, not sent. Nothing is hidden.
Newest first. A rule fires once; fired and cancelled rules stay listed.

schema.title: Response Get Rules Api Rules Get

post.description:
Create a standing instruction from structured fields (the same object the assistant uses).

A rule never sends an order: when it fires it prepares an approval card or an alert.

schema.title: Response Get Audit Api Audit Get

get.description: Downloadable session log: one JSON event per line, oldest first.

post.description: Re-check orders whose outcome was unknown (e.g. after a timeout). Never re-sends.
Ask the copilot. Order requests come back as cards; nothing is ever sent from here.

get.description:
Never returns data. It exists so the WebSocket message types appear in the OpenAPI
schema and the generated TypeScript types.

schema.title: Response Ws Events Doc Api Ws Events Get

get.description: Which provider transcribes, so the microphone can say where the audio goes. Loads nothing.

schema.title: Response Get Profile Api Profile Get
Response Get Presets Api Profile Presets Get
Response Get Goal Api Goal Get

post.description: Places 2 TCS straight on the mock broker, the way 021's own app would: no card, no TradeDesk send log.

AccountLocks.title: AccountLocks
AccountLocks.description: 021's discipline features as the copilot must respect them.

AmbiguityCard.title: AmbiguityCard
AmbiguityCard.description: 'Which Tata?': the trader must pick; the copilot never guesses.

ApprovalConflict.title: ApprovalConflict
ApprovalConflict.description: Body of a 409 from the approve route. Nothing was sent.

ApproveRequest.title: ApproveRequest
ApproveRequest.description: The client must echo the hash of the exact card it is approving.

Charges.title: Charges
Charges.description:
021's charge breakdown for one order, in paise.

`clearing` is kept for the plan's 8-part list; 021's pricing page lists no clearing
charge for equity, so it is 0. `dp_charge` is the per-ISIN depository charge 021
levies on delivery sells.

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: The stock, as the trader said it

comparator.description: BELOW: fires when the price falls under the trigger. ABOVE: rises over it

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: Size of the move as a positive number, e.g. 3 for '3%'

basis.description: With percent: AVG_BUY (their buy price), PREV_CLOSE, or AT_CREATION (default)

CreateRuleRequest.title: CreateRuleRequest
CreateRuleRequest.description:
A standing instruction, in the units a trader uses (rupees, percent).

Give the trigger as EITHER an absolute `price_rupees` OR a `percent` move measured from
`basis`. A TRIGGER_ORDER rule never sends anything when it fires: it prepares a fresh order
card for the trader to approve. An ALERT only tells the trader.

DisciplineSummary.title: DisciplineSummary
DisciplineSummary.description: Today's trading against the trader's OWN limits. Facts only: no advice, no predictions.

ExecutionResult.title: ExecutionResult
ExecutionResult.description:
What happened after an approved card was sent.

SENT      the broker accepted it (see `order` for its live status)
REJECTED  the broker refused it (`order.rejection_reason` says why)
UNKNOWN   the request timed out and we could not confirm either way. The order is
          never re-sent; it is reconciled against the broker's order book.

ExternalOrderEvent.title: ExternalOrderEvent
ExternalOrderEvent.description: An order in the broker's book that this app did not send (placed in 021's own app, for example).

FutureRef-Input.title: FutureRef
FutureRef-Input.description: Which futures contract the trader named. Code finds the exact contract.

FutureRef-Output.title: FutureRef
FutureRef-Output.description: Which futures contract the trader named. Code finds the exact contract.

start_value.title: Start Value
start_value.description: Portfolio value in paise, captured by the backend when saved.

note.title: Note
note.default: Arithmetic against your chosen goal, not a forecast. Deposits and withdrawals affect portfolio value.

GoalRequest.title: GoalRequest
GoalRequest.description:
User-entered goal. The server captures start_value; callers cannot supply it.

Amount fields use paise to match the existing API. Convert rupees at the UI boundary.
start_date may be omitted; when provided it must be today's Indian trading date.

note.title: Note
note.default: Past days don't predict future ones.

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: Unrealised P&L in paise vs average price (negative quantity = short).

pnl_pct.title: Pnl Pct
pnl_pct.description: P&L as a percentage of the amount invested, rounded to 2 decimals.

day_pnl.title: Day Pnl
day_pnl.description: Today's P&L in paise vs previous close.

NoticeCard.title: NoticeCard
NoticeCard.description: Something the trader should know: a block, a lock, or flagged content.

note.title: Note
note.default: Starting values; change them to your own. These are not recommendations.

OptionRef-Input.title: OptionRef
OptionRef-Input.description: Which option contract the trader named. Code finds the exact contract; nothing here is trusted as a price.

OptionRef-Output.title: OptionRef
OptionRef-Output.description: Which option contract the trader named. Code finds the exact contract; nothing here is trusted as a price.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Broker-side order state, as reported by the broker.

OrderIntent-Input.title: OrderIntent
OrderIntent-Input.description: The only order-shaped object the LLM may emit. Not an order: code resolves and validates it.

OrderIntent-Output.title: OrderIntent
OrderIntent-Output.description: The only order-shaped object the LLM may emit. Not an order: code resolves and validates it.

order_hash.title: Order Hash
order_hash.description:
Hash of the exact order. Excludes LTP, expiry and state on purpose.

Price drift is handled by the drift check and re-quote; the hash only binds what
the trader approved: what, how much, at what price, under which idempotency key.

PendingOrder.title: PendingOrder
PendingOrder.description: An exact order awaiting the trader's click. Built by code only.

plan_hash.title: Plan Hash
plan_hash.description: Binds the approval to every leg, its caps, and the failure policy.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: Several orders approved together (shown to the trader as a basket order).

PlanApproveRequest.title: PlanApproveRequest
PlanApproveRequest.description: The client must echo the hash of the exact plan it is approving (every step, cap and policy).

instrument.title: Instrument
instrument.description: The stock, as the trader said it

fraction_of_holding.title: Fraction Of Holding
fraction_of_holding.description: SELL only: a fraction of the shares held. 'half my Infosys' -> 0.5, 'all' -> 1

proceeds_of_leg.title: Proceeds Of Leg
proceeds_of_leg.description: BUY only: spend the money raised by this earlier SELL step (0 = the first step)

order_type.description: LIMIT if the trader gave a price, otherwise MARKET

PlanLegRequest.title: PlanLegRequest
PlanLegRequest.description: One step of a plan, in the units a trader uses. Give exactly ONE way to size it.

PlanReportUpdateEvent.title: PlanReportUpdateEvent
PlanReportUpdateEvent.description: Progress of an approved plan: sent after every step finishes.

PlanUpdatedEvent.title: PlanUpdatedEvent
PlanUpdatedEvent.description: A plan changed state (approved, running, completed, halted, expired, voided, re-quoted).

pnl.title: Pnl
pnl.description: Unrealised P&L in paise vs average price (negative quantity = short).

pnl_pct.title: Pnl Pct
pnl_pct.description: P&L as a percentage of the amount invested, rounded to 2 decimals.

day_pnl.title: Day Pnl
day_pnl.description: Today's P&L in paise vs previous close.

note.title: Note
note.default: Starting values; change them to your own. These are not recommendations.

ProposePlanRequest.title: ProposePlanRequest
ProposePlanRequest.description:
Several orders approved together as one plan, e.g. 'sell half my Infosys and buy ITC with the money'.

Steps run in order. Nothing is sent until the trader approves the whole plan, and by default
a step that does not complete stops the rest.

RuleFiredEvent.title: RuleFiredEvent
RuleFiredEvent.description: A standing instruction just triggered. Show it prominently (toast + the card, if any).

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.description: True: the broker received the order but the reply was lost (the dangerous case)

TraceEvent.title: TraceEvent
TraceEvent.description:
One step of the assistant's work, for the live activity panel (see app/trace.py).

`detail` is a short sentence for people. It never holds keys, passwords or raw broker replies.
